Answer: C
Reason: The provided axial CT image demonstrates a soft tissue mass in the left paratracheal/mediastinal region adjacent to the trachea and great vessels. On a chest X-ray, this pathology would manifest as enlargement of the left hilum or superior mediastinum, which correlates with dysphonia due to compression or invasion of the left recurrent laryngeal nerve by the tracheal squamous cell carcinoma.
